== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Wedge In Red Squadron 1 (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (<code>1261_107</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 112), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-112-Wedge_In_Red_Squadron_1.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-wedgeinredsquadron1-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Wedge In Red Squadron 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]. The Master List slip prints this text without card art.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, Light Side (p. 51), official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]; original http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Permanent pilot is •Wedge, who provides ability of 3. During a battle with opponent’s [Independent Starship] starship, may add one destiny to total power or attrition. Immune to Come With Me, Tallon Roll, and attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_107</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 112 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-112-Wedge_In_Red_Squadron_1-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
